agent.name: MarketNow — Agent Security & Trust Infrastructure
agent.description: Security and trust infrastructure for AI agents: Sentinel, a 12-stage / 10-layer audit pipeline (L1 index certification, L1.5–L1.9 static analysis, L2 deep tarball scans, L2.5 gVisor sandbox, L3 runtime monitoring), ATC/1.0 Agent Trust Cards, revocation registry and tool fingerprinting — with a 68,388-server indexed MCP catalog as the discovery and distribution layer (132,737 tracked across the ecosystem). Agents can discover, install, and recommend MCP skills to other agents, earning commission on referrals. Supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), A2A (Agent-to-Agent), and JSON-RPC transports.

tools.name: marketnow_search_skills
tools.description: Search the MarketNow registry of indexed MCP servers (68k+ across GitHub, npm and PyPI)

tools.name: marketnow_verify_trust
tools.description: Verify any AI agent credential (ATC v3, JWT/OAuth, W3C VC, MCP Card, A2A, EAT-AI, ZTA, SPIFFE SVID, X.509) through the UTA 12-stage credential-verification pipeline (PARSE→DECISION — distinct from Sentinel's 12 skill-audit stages). Returns validity, format, trust score, and issues.

tools.name: marketnow_translate_credential
tools.description: Translate a credential between the 9 adapter formats (ATC, JWT/OAuth, W3C VC, A2A, EAT-AI, ZTA, MCP Card, SPIFFE, X.509). Lossless conversion through Universal Trust Schema (UTS). See /api/trust?action=formats.

tools.name: marketnow_list_formats
tools.description: List all 9 supported credential adapter formats (ATC, EAT-AI, ZTA, A2A, MCP Card, W3C VC, OAuth, SPIFFE, X.509) with their algorithms and status.

tools.name: marketnow_check_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is suspicious (scam checker). Returns risk score and reasons

tools.name: marketnow_check_revocation
tools.description: Check revocation status of an ATC (card_id) or CA key (kid) against the signed CRL

tools.name: marketnow_fingerprint_tool
tools.description: Cryptographically fingerprint MCP tool definitions (SHA-256 + RFC 8785 JCS) against tool poisoning

tools.name: marketnow_submit_skill
tools.description: Publish a skill to the MarketNow catalog (write side, Sentinel-validated)

mcp.tools_note: The remote endpoint (marketnow.site/api/mcp) exposes 9 public discovery/trust tools. The npm package marketnow-mcp@1.14.1 exposes 15 LOCAL trust/security tools (verify_trust, verify_receipt, check_revocation, fingerprint_tool, mint_referral, ...) that run client-side against local credentials and the public APIs. Remote discovery surface and local package surface are different by design.

services.name: MCP Skill Search
services.description: AI agents can search and retrieve MCP server configurations from 68,388 index-certified entries. Supports natural language queries, category filtering, and security score thresholds.

atc.description: Agent Trust Card — identity, trust score, and payment for AI agents. The trust layer for A2A + MCP.

sentinelL1.scoreRange: sentinel_score 0-10 per entry; index certification is binary (all 10 checks pass)
sentinelL1.passRate: 683,876/683,880 index checks pass (99.999%); 4 smithery-sourced entries carry documented C4 provenance exceptions (url=null) — see /api/certification.json checks
sentinelL1.exceptionsNote: 4 entries with url=null provenance (smithery imports) — documented, not hidden

economy.model: Security infrastructure with commission: listing and installation are free; revenue comes from Sentinel subscriptions (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402) is billed 100% vendor-side.
economy.buyer_pricing: Free. Buyers never pay MarketNow. Vendor-priced usage (e.g. per-call x402) is billed by the vendor directly.

seller_pricing.listing: Free — list unlimited skills at no cost
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_PRO: $9.99/mo — Sentinel v3.0 audit on every skill
seller_pricing.SENTINEL_ENTERPRISE: $49.99/mo — gVisor sandbox + priority listing + API access

economy.seller_revenue: Sellers keep 80% of every premium skill sale. MarketNow takes 20% commission.
revenue_streams: 20% commission on premium skill sales (main revenue)
economy.buyer_value: All 68,388 catalog entries install free. Vendor-priced usage (x402) is billed by the vendor — MarketNow verifies security, not pricing.
economy.seller_value: Publish to the 68,388-server catalog and its agent traffic. Keep 80% of sales. Sentinel audits boost trust and conversion.

audit_applied.auditor: Independent audit via Z.ai (not affiliated with AliceLabs LLC)
audit_applied.audit_scope: Documented inconsistencies across agent.json, npm package.json, LICENSE files, README, and landing HTML.

metrics.security_checks_methodology: 766,211 total = 683,880 L1 (10 L1 checks × 68,388 entries) + 82,331 L2 (29 L2 rules × 2,839 tarballs; top 2,868 npm targets, 99% completion)

pricing_source_of_truth: agent.json is the canonical pricing source. Landing page and README must match. MarketNow does NOT sell skills to buyers — buyers install all 68,388 skills free. Revenue comes from sellers who subscribe to Sentinel (PRO $9.99/mo, ENTERPRISE $49.99/mo) and 20% commission on seller sales.

buyer_pricing.explanation: Buyers never pay MarketNow. All 68,388 skills are free to install.

api_notes.skills_pagination: The /api/skills endpoint is paginated (default 100 per page, max 500). The old /api/skills.json dump was REMOVED 2026-09-25 (audit F-06, it had grown to 94MB) — that URL now returns a deprecation manifest; use /api/skills?page=1&limit=100 or /api/skills-lite.json instead.

taxonomy.sentinel: 12 pipeline stages (L1 index certification → L8-L9 post-execution filter) grouped into 10 audit layers — audits SKILLS / catalog artifacts. See /security/sentinel-v3.0
taxonomy.uta_verification: 12 credential-verification stages (PARSE → DETECT → SCHEMA → CRYPTO → ISSUER → KEY_BINDING → POP → PROVENANCE → LIFECYCLE → EVIDENCE → POLICY → DECISION) — verifies CREDENTIALS (ATC, JWT, W3C VC, X.509…). See /api/trust?action=pipeline
taxonomy.atc_1_0: 10 credential verification controls (8 required + 2 optional) — see /atc/spec/SPEC.md section 2
taxonomy.uta_adapters: 9 trust-credential format adapters (ATC, EAT-AI, ZTA, A2A, MCP Card, W3C VC, OAuth, SPIFFE, X.509) — npm @marketnow/trust-adapters. See /uta
taxonomy.note: Four counts, four different systems — not four ways of counting the same thing: Sentinel counts skill-audit stages; UTA verification counts credential-verification stages (both happen to be 12 — coincidence, not double-counting); ATC/1.0 counts credential verification controls; UTA adapters counts supported credential formats.
